[[File:Trumpet_weeds.png|right|thumb|Fossilized trumpet weeds holding marine pearls]]
The '''trumpet weed''' was a type of large [[Plant/Legends|plant]] with cup-like ends found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Once fossilized, trumpet weeds could be polished and turned into art objects. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of Dac around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], once offered his colleague [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] three large pearls from the seas of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], held in the ends of such fossilized trumpet weeds.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|32|COR 11-12|Coruscant &ndash; Palpatine's Apartments}}</ref> The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] senator subsequently displayed them in his [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|apartment suite]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> as a part of his collection of historic art and artifacts.<ref name="FF" />

==Behind the scenes==
A set of three fossilized trumpet weeds appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> In real life, "trumpet weed" is one of the vernacular names of the [[Wikipedia:Eutrochium purpureum|''Eutrochium purpureum'']], a [[Wikipedia:North America|North American]] flowering plant with white blossoms.<ref name="Flora">{{WebCite|url=http://www.florafinder.com/Species/Eupatorium_purpureum.php|text=Eupatorium purpureum|work=FloraFinder.com|archivedate=20140903155032}}</ref>
